rule: The canonical v0.11.1 historical release is restored and reconciled. Evidence reconciliation is complete enough to bound the six remaining v1 MUST clusters. No successor implementation is admitted until its objective gap is preregistered and frozen.

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: Sealed evidence covers substantial MUST-02 through MUST-06 behavior, including deterministic discovery, traceability, task compilation, prompt/context compilation and execution resume. The complete MUST-01 representative end-to-end real-project lifecycle claim is not yet proven.
completion_evidence: claim-by-claim mapping from v1 MUST-01..06 to exact evidence

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: Existing impact/provenance evidence is narrower than MUST-07. No authoritative mutation matrix covering specifications, decisions, trace graph, tasks, prompts, tests, manifests, dependency definitions and release-authoritative artifacts was found in the sealed/current tree.
objective_v1_must_blockers.v1_capability_advanced: MUST-07 and MUST-08 change propagation, determinism and provenance
objective_v1_must_blockers.expected_information_value: Highest currently bounded gap: freshness errors can invalidate otherwise-correct automation and downstream evidence.
completion_evidence: determinism/provenance evidence mapped to exact v1 claims

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: The frozen v0.10 protocol and 3/3 separate-context trials provide narrow transfer/resume/reconstruction evidence, but final v1 real-project transfer/rework claims and denominators have not yet been fully bounded and reconciled.
completion_evidence: claim-limited reconciliation with uncertainty and limitations

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: Exact package identity, ownership/hash universes, clean restoration validation and active regression memory are preserved, but MUST-11 threat-model/adversarial-security evidence is not established by package-integrity results alone.
objective_v1_must_blockers.v1_capability_advanced: MUST-10 through MUST-12 packaging, security/data integrity and regression memory
completion_evidence: package/install/clean-extraction evidence mapped to v1 scope
security threat model and adversarial/transaction-integrity evidence
active regression ledger and retirement rules

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: A substantial CLI and documentation surface exists, but candidate-exact end-to-end example reproduction, CLI/API contract verification and structured actionable-diagnostic evidence required by MUST-13/14 are not yet reconciled to PASS.
objective_v1_must_blockers.v1_capability_advanced: MUST-13 and MUST-14 documentation/examples and usability

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: The historical v0.11.1 lineage is reconciled, but MUST-15/16 are terminal v1-candidate gates and cannot complete until substantive v1 MUST gaps are closed.
objective_v1_must_blockers.v1_capability_advanced: MUST-15 and MUST-16 independent verification and final release lineage
completion_evidence: zero unresolved substantive v1 MUST blockers
authoritative shipping manifest and clean extraction
completion receipt, release notes, version 1.0.0 and tag/release where tooling permits

convergence_review.question: What specifically prevents v1.00 right now?
convergence_review.answer: Six MUST clusters remain. Evidence reconciliation bounded them; the first objective implementation-relevant gap is MUST-07 authoritative freshness/change propagation. Its preregistration is next; implementation remains unauthorized until freeze.
